description:
Increase the global file upload size limit in JFrog Artifactory to support larger artifacts. 

1. Open Firefox and log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using the credentials: username 'admin', password 'password'.
2. Navigate to the Administration module (gear icon).
3. Go to Artifactory > General > Settings (or General Configuration).
4. Locate the 'File Upload Max Size (MB)' setting.
5. Change the value to exactly '500'.
6. Save the changes.
